unit: Algebra · Chapter 1. Systems of linear equations
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 8 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The graph of a linear equation in two unknowns is a line; the solution of a system is the intersection point of the two lines.
stages.headlineEnglish: The graph of a linear equation in two unknowns is a line; the solution of a system is the intersection point of the two lines.

stages.headline: If the lines are parallel the system has no solution; if they coincide it has infinitely many.
stages.headlineEnglish: If the lines are parallel the system has no solution; if they coincide it has infinitely many.

stages.headline: The graphical method gives an approximate answer but clearly shows how many solutions there are.
stages.headlineEnglish: The graphical method gives an approximate answer but clearly shows how many solutions there are.
